sn55.7:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena veḷudvāraṃ nāma kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
sn55.7:1.4: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ veḷudvāraṃ anuppatto.
sn55.7:1.5: taṃ kho pana bhagavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
sn55.7:1.6: “itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathī satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.7:1.7: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
sn55.7:1.8: so dhammaṃ deseti: “ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
sn55.7:1.9: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti.
sn55.7:2.1: atha kho veḷudvāreyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā appekacce bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. appekacce bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu. sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. appekacce yena bhagavā tenañjaliṃ paṇāmetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. appekacce bhagavato santike nāmagottaṃ sāvetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. appekacce tuṇhībhūtā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho veḷudvāreyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn55.7:2.2: mayaṃ bho gotama, evaṃ kāmā evañchandā evaṃ adhippāyā
sn55.7:2.3: puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvaseyyāma. kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhaveyyāma mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhāreyyāma, jātarūparajataṃ sādiyeyyāma. kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyāma.
sn55.7:2.4: tesaṃ no bhavaṃ gotamo amhākaṃ evaṃkāmānaṃ evañchandānaṃ evaṃ adhippāyānaṃ tathā dhammaṃ desetu. yathā mayaṃ puttasambādhasayanaṃ ajjhāvaseyyāma, kāsikacandanaṃ paccanubhaveyyāma, mālāgandhavilepanaṃ dhāreyyāma, jātarūparajataṃ sādiyeyyāma. kāyassa ca bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyāmāti.
sn55.7:3.3: evaṃ bhoti kho veḷudvāreyyaka brāhmaṇagahapatikā bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
sn55.7:4.4: yo kho maṃ jīvitukāmaṃ amaritukāmaṃ sukhakāmaṃ dukkhapaṭikkūlaṃ jīvitā voropeyya, na metaṃ assa piyaṃ manāpaṃ
sn55.7:4.5: ahañceva kho pana paraṃ jīvitukāmaṃ amaritukāmaṃ. sukhakāmaṃ dukkhapaṭikkūlaṃ jīvitā voropeyya parassapi taṃ assa appiyaṃ amanāpaṃ.
sn55.7:4.6: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo. parassapeso dhammo appiyo amanāpo.
sn55.7:4.7: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo, kathāhaṃ paraṃ tena saṃyojeyyanti,?
sn55.7:4.8: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya attanā ca pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti. parañca pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā samādapeti. pāṇātipātā veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
sn55.7:5.1: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati:
sn55.7:5.2: “yo kho me adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyeyya, na me taṃ assa piyaṃ manāpaṃ.
sn55.7:5.3: ahañceva kho pana parassa adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādiyeyyaṃ, parassapi taṃ assa appiyaṃ amanāpaṃ.
sn55.7:5.4: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo, parassa peso dhammo appiyo amanāpo.
sn55.7:5.5: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo, kathāhaṃ parentena saṃyojeyyanti”?
sn55.7:5.6: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya attanā ca adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, parañca adinnādānā veramaṇiyā samādapeti, adinnādānā veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
sn55.7:6.1: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati:
sn55.7:6.2: “yo kho me dāresu cārittaṃ āpajjeyya, na metaṃ assa piyaṃ manāpaṃ
sn55.7:6.3: ahañceva kho pana parassa dāresu cārittaṃ āpajjeyyaṃ, parassapi taṃ assa appiyaṃ amanāpaṃ.
sn55.7:6.4: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo, parassa peso dhammo appiyo amanāpo.
sn55.7:6.5: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo, kathāhaṃ parantena saṃyojeyyanti”?
sn55.7:6.6: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya attanā ca kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti. parañca kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇiyā samādapeti, kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
sn55.7:7.1: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo, ariyasāvako iti paṭisaṃcikkhati:
sn55.7:7.2: yo kho me musāvādena atthaṃ bhañjeyya, na metaṃ assa piyaṃ manāpaṃ.
sn55.7:7.3: ahaṃ ceva kho pana parassa musāvādena atthaṃ bhañjeyyaṃ parassapi taṃ assa appiyaṃ amanāpaṃ.
sn55.7:7.4: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo, parassa peso dhammo appiyo amanāpo.
sn55.7:7.5: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo, kathāhaṃ parantena saṃyojeyyanti?
sn55.7:7.6: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya attanā ca musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, parañca musāvādā veramaṇiyā samādapeti. musāvādā veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
sn55.7:8.1: puna caparaṃ gahapatayo, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati:
sn55.7:8.2: “yo kho maṃ pisuṇāya vācāya mitte bhindeyya, na me taṃ assa piyaṃ manāpaṃ.
sn55.7:8.3: ahaṃ ceva kho pana paraṃ pisunāya vācāya mitte bhindeyyaṃ parassapi taṃ assa appiyaṃ amanāpaṃ.
sn55.7:10.4: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo, parassa peso dhammo appiyo amanāpo.
sn55.7:10.5: yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo, kathāhaṃ parantena saṃyojeyyanti? so iti paṭisaṅkhāya attanā ca pisunāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti. parañca pisunāya vācāya veramaṇiyā samādapeti. pisunāya vācāya veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. evamassāyaṃ vacīsamācāro tikoṭiparisuddho hoti. puna caparaṃ gahapatayo, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati, yo kho maṃ pharusāya vācāya samudācareyya, na me taṃ assa piyaṃ manāpaṃ. ahaṃ ceva kho pana paraṃ pharusāya vācāya samudācareyyaṃ, parassapi taṃ assa appiyaṃ amanāpaṃ. yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo, parassapeso dhammo appiyo amanāpo. yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo. kathāhaṃ paraṃ tena saṃyojeyyanti? so iti paṭisaṅkhāya attanā ca pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti. parañca pharusāya vācāya veramaṇiyā samādapeti. pharusāya vācāya veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. evamassāyaṃ vacīsamācāro tikoṭiparisuddho hoti. puna caparaṃ gahapatayo, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati: “yo kho maṃ samphappalāpabhāsena samudācareyya. na me taṃ assa piyaṃ manāpaṃ. ahañceva kho pana paraṃ samphappalāpabhāsena samudācareyyaṃ, parassapi taṃ assa appiyaṃ amanāpaṃ. yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo, parassapeso dhammo appiyo amanāpo. yo kho myāyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo, kathāhaṃ paraṃ tena saṃyojeyyanti”?
sn55.7:10.6: so iti paṭisaṅkhāya attanā ca samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti, parañca samphappalāpā veramaṇiyā samādapeti. samphappalāpā veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati.
sn55.7:11.2: “itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti”.
sn55.7:11.4: saṅghe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti: “supaṭipanno bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti”.
sn55.7:11.5: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.7:11.6: yato kho gahapatayo, ariyasāvako imehi sattahi dhammehi samannāgato hoti. imehi catūhi ākaṅkhiyehi ṭhānehi. so ākaṅkhamāno attanāva attānaṃ vyākareyya:
sn55.7:11.7: “khīṇanirayomhi khīṇatiracchānayoniyo khīṇapettivisayo khīṇāpāyaduggativinipāto. sotāpannohamasmi avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo”ti.
sn55.7:12.1: evaṃ vutte veḷudvāreyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā bhagavantaṃ etadavocuṃ:
sn55.7:12.3: ete mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi, dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
sn55.7:12.4: upāsake no bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupete saraṇaṃ gateti”.
